Correct facts are provided; wrong facts are incorrect. A broad request for a recap or details is not an explicit request for each detail.

Optional offers of other actions are answers, not clarification. For factual recall, asking a clarification is not a separate style failure; grade whether the expected facts were conveyed. Judge behavioral criteria only against the authored expectation and what the answer actually does. For a negative behavior criterion such as not claiming an outing is cancelled, absence of that claim satisfies it. A cancellation acknowledgement proves only the acknowledgement.
